in_hebrew.name: Wilt
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Wilt הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word wiltan, meaning to will or to want. The name Wilt signifies a person who is willing, resilient, and determined. This name has Germanic origins and is used primarily in the English-speaking world.
